description: Categorisation expectations for the AML scope (MONDO_0018874). Each is grounded in live evidence fetched 2026-09-20, NOT in memory; the 'evidence' field says where to re-check it. The exporter reports PASS/FAIL against these on every run and never edits the tree to make them pass.

expectations.claim: Decitabine is approved at a BROADER term (myeloid leukemia) by the EU only; its US labels are MDS-only.
expectations.evidence: OT clinical_report: DailyMed x8 (MDS/CMML/RAEB/anemia), EMA + EMA Human Drugs (myeloid leukemia). openFDA Dacogen/generic labels 2020-2026: MDS only.

expectations.claim: Cedazuridine is approved at a broader term by the EU; the current US Inqovi label adds an AML clause only IN COMBINATION with venetoclax.
expectations.evidence: OT: EMA Human Drugs (leukemia, myeloid), FDA (myelodysplastic syndrome). openFDA INQOVI label eff. 20260525 item 1.1 MDS + 'In combination with venetoclax ... newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia'.

expectations.claim: Venetoclax has NO Open Targets regulatory report for AML (only CLL/SLL), yet the US Venclexta label names AML with azacitidine, decitabine, or low-dose cytarabine.
expectations.evidence: OT: DailyMed/FDA/PMDA CLL, EMA CLL. openFDA Venclexta label indications.

expectations.claim: ENASIDENIB (parent CHEMBL3989908, Phase 3) and ENASIDENIB MESYLATE (salt CHEMBL3989931, approved) are ONE drug and must be merged by parentId.
NCT04657081 (ASTX727 + venetoclax) resolves to the regimen decitabine + cedazuridine + venetoclax, and that regimen matches the Inqovi label's AML clause.
expectations.evidence: AACT design_groups: one arm with 'Decitabine and Cedazuridine (ASTX727)' + 'Venetoclax'; OT synonym 'CEDAZURIDINE COMPONENT OF ASTX727'.

expectations.claim: NCT02993523 (VIALE-A) counts under venetoclax + azacitidine, and its 'Placebo + Azacitidine' arm is NOT counted as an azacitidine-monotherapy regimen.
expectations.evidence: AACT design_groups: arm typed PLACEBO_COMPARATOR contains a Placebo intervention; the venetoclax arm is typed ACTIVE_COMPARATOR (arm type is unreliable, so contents decide).
